page_title: AI Stock Photos, 3D Icons & Mockups - Edit with AI | Woopicx

sources.entry: Woopicx - AI-powered image search engine with 100,000+ free icons, illustrations, and 3D assets across 80+ categories.

summary.name: Woopicx
summary.one_liner: Woopicx is an online library of AI-generated stock photos, 3D icons, mockups and landing page templates that can be edited with text prompts.
use_cases: Finding ready-made stock visuals for a project
Editing an image by describing changes in text
Starting a landing page from a template
Creating social media story videos from catalog photos
Animating a still image into video
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a library of over 60,000 AI-generated stock photos, 3D icons and mockups, with about 27.9k 3D icons across 96 categories delivered as PNG with transparent backgrounds and animated video versions. Users can edit images by typing commands such as changing text, colors or objects. The page also mentions animating images into video and generating new visuals with nanabanana AI. Curated collections include landing page designs for AI agent products, AI story templates, and 3D icon landing page templates with downloadable code and a README for AI-assisted rebranding. Assets are offered under a commercial license with no attribution required, and new assets are added daily.
notable: AI image editing by text commands (change text, colors, objects)
27.9k 3D icons across 96 categories with transparent PNG and animated video versions
Landing page and story templates with code and README for AI assistants to rebrand
Energy-based credits for AI tools on paid plans plus one-time Extra Pack
caveats: AI tools use an energy allowance tied to subscription plans (80, 190, 390 energy/mo listed) and an Extra Pack for top-ups
Cloud storage is limited by plan (100 MB, 300 MB, 600 MB)
Page describes free browsing and weekly free assets, but full access collections appear to require a paid plan
